q1.explanationZh: 第二段说 2003 年 6 月 Stout 和别的 12 岁女孩差不多，后来医生查出她得了骨癌，所以是 12 岁。

evidence.quote: In June 2003, Stout was very much like any other 12-year-old girl.

q2.rubricZh: 要点：回答 No（没有承诺治愈癌症）。
q2.explanationZh: 第四段说 MAW 基金会是帮助有需要的孩子实现愿望的，并没有说要治好她的癌症，所以回答 No。

evidence.quote: It helps children in need fulfil their wishes.

q3.sampleAnswer: Because she had already experienced many wonderful things in her life, such as going to Disney World, swimming with dolphins in Mexico and going to the beach all the time.

keyPoints.descZh: 她已经经历过很多美好的事（如去迪士尼、和海豚游泳、常去海边）
examples: She had already experienced many wonderful things.
She had been to Disney World and swum with dolphins.

q3.rubricZh: 要点：她已经经历过很多美好的事情，如去迪士尼世界、在墨西哥和海豚游泳、常去海边（答出其中一两件也可）。
q3.explanationZh: Stout 自己说她还是很幸运，因为她去过迪士尼、和海豚一起游过泳，还常去海边，已经过得很精彩。

evidence.quote: I have been to Disney World and swum with dolphins in Mexico.

q4.sampleAnswer: To let all 155 kids on the MAW waiting list fulfil their wishes.

keyPoints.descZh: 让等候名单上的155个孩子都实现愿望
examples: To let all 155 kids on the waiting list have their wishes fulfilled.
Her wish is to let their wishes be fulfilled—all 155 of them.

q4.rubricZh: 要点：让 MAW 等候名单上的 155 个孩子都实现愿望。
q4.explanationZh: MAW 问她想要什么时，她没有为自己许愿，而是希望名单上 155 个孩子的愿望都能实现。

evidence.quote: my wish is to let their wishes be fulfilled—all 155 of them.

q5.rubricZh: 要点：2004年1月16日（只答 January 16 也可）。
q5.explanationZh: 最后一段说 Stout 在 2004 年 1 月 4 日去世，1 月 16 日 MAW 宣布已经筹够了钱。

evidence.quote: On January 16, MAW announced that they had raised $1,116,000

q6.sampleAnswer: she was a selfless and brave young girl who thought of others even while suffering from cancer.(Answers may vary.)

keyPoints.descZh: 概括她无私、勇敢、心里想着别人等品质
examples: she was a selfless and brave girl
she cared about others even when she was ill

q6.rubricZh: 开放题，答案不唯一。要点：根据全文，对 Stout 作出合理、通顺的概括（如无私、勇敢、乐观、关心他人）。
q6.explanationZh: 这是开放题。Stout 生病了还想着帮别人实现愿望，没有放弃希望，所以可以说她无私又勇敢。

evidence.quote: my wish is to let their wishes be fulfilled—all 155 of them.

q7.explanationZh: “我和另外四个人合住一栋房子”，这里表示“分享、合住”，主语是 I，用原形 share。

evidence.quote: It helps children in need fulfil their wishes.

q8.explanationZh: “她没买，因为它花钱太多”，cost 是“花费”，它的过去式也是 cost，所以选 B。

q9.explanationZh: “那是 20 年前的事，之后一切都变了”，have 后面要用过去分词 changed。

evidence.quote: Then, something magical happened. It changed many lives.

q10.explanationZh: help 后面可以接动词原形，“帮忙筹钱来修体育场”，所以选 raise。

evidence.quote: donations poured into the MAW office even faster.

q11.explanationZh: force sth. on sb. 是“把某物强加给某人”，这里是过去式，所以选 forced。

evidence.quote: she was forced to use a wheelchair to get around

q12.explanationZh: “爷爷最大的愿望是……”，wish 作名词是“愿望”，所以选 wish。

evidence.quote: my wish is to let their wishes be fulfilled—all 155 of them.

q13.explanationZh: 原句是一般过去时，变一般疑问句要在句首加 Did，后面的动词用原形 begin。

q14.explanationZh: 原句是一般过去时，且 little 表示“几乎没有”，是否定意思，所以反意疑问句用肯定形式 did they。
q14.tipsZh: 含 little、few、never 的句子算否定句，后面用肯定的附加问句

q15.explanationZh: 画线部分是原因（它要花近75万美元），所以用 Why 提问，问句是 Why was it hard for MAW to fulfill Stout’s wish?

q16.explanationZh: didn’t live to see 的肯定形式是 lived to see，意思是“活着看到”。
q16.tipsZh: live to do sth. 活着做到某事

q17.explanationZh: 先说主语和谓语 she was looking forward to，再说 the trip，用 but 连接后一句 a sudden pain changed everything。
q17.tipsZh: look forward to sth. 期待某事
